Answer with a list of items, instead of bullet points use -. No two consecutive words can share the same first letter. write a description of the 20th century in an over-dramatic, biblical styleassistant
response:
- Aeon of Unrelenting Turmoil - The 20th century dawned like a tempest, shrouding the world in an impenetrable veil of strife and woe.

- Cataclysmic Wars - The Great War, a conflict of unprecedented ferocity, ravaged the earth, leaving in its wake a trail of devastation and despair.

- Fateful Rise of Totalitarian Regimes - As the world teetered on the brink of chaos, dark empires arose, their iron-fisted grip crushing all opposition beneath their heel.

- Global Economic Collapse - The very foundations of civilization trembled as the global economy careened out of control, plunging humanity into a darkness of want and desperation.

- Humanitarian Horrors - The 20th century was a crucible of unspeakable atrocities, as the worst excesses of human nature were unleashed upon the world.

- Industrialization's Dark Legacy - The relentless march of progress, fueled by the insatiable hunger for power and profit, left in its wake a scarred and barren landscape.

- Mass Migration and Displacement - As the world burned, millions were forced to flee their homes, seeking refuge in a desolate and unforgiving landscape.

- Nuclear Apocalypse - The specter of annihilation loomed large, as the threat of nuclear war hung over humanity like the sword of Damocles.

- Pandemics and Plagues - The 20th century was a time of unrelenting pestilence, as deadly diseases swept across the globe, claiming countless lives and leaving in their wake a trail of suffering.

- Perilous Politics - The world was a stage for the grand drama of geopolitics, as nations clashed and alliances were forged and broken with reckless abandon.

- Racial and Ethnic Tensions - The 20th century was a time of unrelenting conflict, as the very fabric of society was torn asunder by the scourge of racism and xenophobia.

- Scientific Breakthroughs - Amidst the chaos, humanity made strides of unprecedented progress, unlocking the secrets of the universe and pushing the boundaries of what was thought possible.

- Technological Terror - The 20th century was a time of wonder and terror, as the rapid pace of technological advancement brought both unprecedented benefits and unspeakable horrors.

- Unprecedented Environmental Degradation - The world was ravaged by the unchecked ravages of human activity, as the very foundations of the ecosystem were torn asunder.

- Vast Social Upheaval - The 20th century was a time of seismic change, as the old certainties were shattered and the world was remade in the image of a new and uncertain reality.

- Wartime Atrocities - The 20th century was a time of unrelenting brutality, as the horrors of war were unleashed upon the world, leaving in their wake a trail of destruction and despair.

- Xenophobia and Nationalism - The 20th century was a time of unrelenting division, as the world was torn apart by the scourge of nationalism and xenophobia.

- Yearning for a New Dawn - And yet, even in the midst of such unrelenting turmoil, humanity held on to the hope of a better tomorrow, a beacon of light in the darkness that would guide us through the trials of the 21st century.
